# Joint even-matter and finite-link interface on a periodic qubit lattice

Claim type: bounded_theorem

**Current status: accepted conditional finite source; proposed_retained is a target, not retained/audit status.** The [root mathematical acceptance](../.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-joint-matter-link-20261014/JOINT_INTERFACE_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json) controls the unchanged 39,236-byte derivation `34cbe355c3cd643e3eb3233560fa53259b5803fa1114e4c8eedabbb40475dbca`. The later [source-assembly review](../.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-joint-matter-link-20261014/ROOT_SOURCE_REVIEW.md) accepts the exact source wrapper and evidence closure for publication preparation. This publication framing, identity tool and integration driver require separate root review and acceptance; the earlier acceptances do not authorize their execution.

The complete author argument follows this wrapper without edits. Its original provisional status, pending-review language, timestamps and local paths remain a historical record of the author seal. The current source disposition is the later acceptance above, read with the [complete root review](../.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-joint-matter-link-20261014/ROOT_FINAL_REVIEW.txt) and [separate full source-exposed review](../.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-joint-matter-link-20261014/FULL_SOURCE_REVIEW.txt). Earlier partial acceptances and open-obligation sentences in the archive retain their original dates and scope; they are not alternate current dispositions.

## Fixed supplied model and conclusion

The statement fixes the coarse torus `(Z/4Z)^3`, six direction modes per coarse cell, the literal port-ordered face-Pauli operators, all displayed local and three Wilson constraints at eigenvalue `+1`, background charge 3 per cell, and `S=1` hard-cutoff links. The matter code encodes the total-even sector; the common Gauss sector has total occupation 192. Each link is an explicitly defined three-state subspace of two additional, disjoint physical qubits. Its nonunitary raising operator has an exact continuous-charge commutator and retains its dark endpoints.

The architecture, macro-origin, code and link preparation, global encoder, Wilson-sector selection, interaction coefficients and framing gates are supplied. There are 1,344 active qubit factors in a finite physical torus `(Z/64Z)^3` with coarse spacing 16; any remaining torus factors are supplied idle factors. The actual coordinates and periodic metric are part of the hypothesis.

| Accepted finite clause | Exact scope |
| --- | --- |
| Nonempty, nontrivial common code | Dimension at least `20^64`; displayed stream and plaquette generators act nontrivially on actual common-code inputs. |
| Joint operator interface | The full even-CAR intertwiner, three-state link embedding and full-operator Gauss/code identities justify the stated stream, intracell, electric and plaquette generators. |
| Physical support and coefficient budget | The specified Hamiltonian term list has arity at most 11, periodic L1 diameter at most 20, and per-active-site interaction-norm sum at most `11J` under its explicit coefficient bounds. Larger whole-cell algebras and constraint projectors are excluded from that term budget. |
| Corrected symmetry | The geometric permutation followed by explicit CZ/Z corrections gives an exact proper-cubic unitary action, including the fixed `+1` Wilson character. Coarse translations extend it to coarse cube centres. Arbitrary coefficients form a covariant family; a fixed invariant Hamiltonian needs the stated coefficient restrictions. |

The Hamiltonian family is Hermitian and preserves the common code under its unsplit finite-time evolution. **It is not generally positive.** As the separate review establishes, the permitted choice `H=-JN` acts as `-192J I` on that code. No positive-energy condition, physical energy-zero choice, selected physical clock or energy scale is added here. No scalar-shift repair or broader positivity theorem is implicit in the interaction-norm bound.

The metric is periodic L1, not the ordinary distance between representatives in an open box. Root's separate geometry control used periodic Chebyshev distance and is not relabeled as an L1 computation. The priced diagonal framing repair does not price the geometric permutation as a bounded-depth local SWAP circuit. These distinctions remain in the complete source.

## Historical definitions, proof and evidence roles

The [Cycle235 note](../archive/notes/docs/work_history/repo/review_feedback/EXACT_3D_HIGHER_FORM_BOSONIZATION_CYCLE235_NOTE_2026-07-17.md) and [literal historical program](../scripts/exact_3d_higher_form_bosonization_cycle235_2026_07_17.py) supply the graph, port orders, normalized cycle/Wilson paths and placement conventions. The [hard-cut link note](U1_QUANTUM_LINK_EXACT_LOCAL_BACKREACTION_AND_COLORED_FLOQUET_ENERGY_FORK_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-03.md) supplies the finite-link definition, while the [encoded U(1) note](THE_FERMIONS_U1_COUPLED_TO_QUANTUM_LINKS_GAUSS_LAW_AS_A_SUPPORT_CONDITION_AMONG_RECORDS_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-03.md) supplies the T/K/directed-transfer provenance and Gauss/record qualifications. These are historical definition/provenance roles. The accepted argument explicitly redeclares the operators and proves the needed finite claims; neither old numerical censuses nor stronger backreaction/Floquet, native, photon or record-formation theorems are imported. The old cross-Majorana docstring is preserved as a historical label, not used as the operator dictionary. Missing G0c modules are not premises.

The archived root sector and rotation lemmas are separately checked corroborating arguments. They were unavailable to the author before its seal and are not retroactively made inputs to the author proof. The finite root checks, separate review and exact literal source binding explain the later acceptance. `PARENT_BINDINGS.json` records the four literal definition roles and actual current source identities. The two U(1) notes are current canonical Markdown citations; the Cycle235 archive note and Python source retain their direct attribution links. Under the current graph builder these links imply one new note, two citation edges and no new root. This is a source-derived expectation for root to verify, not a graph run or an import of those notes’ stronger theorems. The history-PR publication ancestry adds no history-theorem premise.

The full author archive preserves all five actual runs, executed source versions, raw streams, receipts, the initial draft, final comment-only change and exposure records. The separate full review includes its sealed preliminary assessment, source/version/stream coverage maps and one disjoint bit-mask Pauli calculation with a different spanning tree and three generating rotations. Root's pre-author-exposure local algebra, cycle-span and geometry proofs/controls, their separate reviews and later author binding are preserved in full. This is same-family, source-exposed corroboration with specific implementation separation; it is not model diversity, blind validation or retained audit. No scientific program was rerun for this assembly.

The archive retains the nonzero raw-A Gauss residual, cyclic-shift boundary defect, wrong-sign cycle dependency and omitted-framing controls. It also retains the root sector lemma's original wording, its exact V2 repair and the two-vertex single-edge counterexample to an unqualified nonzero-transfer statement. These are scoped failures of particular substitutions or assertions, not universal no-go theorems. Identity checks document bytes and extraction; they execute zero mathematical predicates and are not evidence of the mathematics by themselves.

## Explicit limits and complete preserved source

The theorem is fixed L=4, background 3 and the stated cutoff/sector. It provides no odd loader, full-Fock access, finite-depth encoder, local or stable preparation, autonomous constraint enforcement, native infinite/open-lattice nearest-neighbor law, unit physical translations, every-physical-site rotation symmetry, selected coupling/energy/time law, physical readout or measurement apparatus. It establishes neither another-volume result, continuum/thermodynamic control, gapless photon/Maxwell phase, dispersion law nor empirical prediction. A nonzero finite flux circulation discharges none of those obligations.

`PUBLICATION_EDITS.json` gives the unique complete proof extraction, exact byte/line ranges and full original-to-publication diffs. The primary identity tool `scripts/joint_even_matter_finite_link_interface_identity_2026_10_14.py` checks source reconstruction only and evaluates zero mathematical predicates.
